C9.interpretation: Removing the restrictive only-written-rules wording and stating that relevant background memory may be used did not make the raw bank's rules behaviorally available. Both target-bank reasonings conclude that no background rules were provided. The visible control is one of two on this new wording and is not treated as a clean control pass.

C10.interpretation: The first paper-style contextualized descriptor variants also did not make the facts usable on A01. Gemma still returned unknown. This rules out raw-only versus contextualized encoding as a sufficient correction on this case; it does not falsify MI generally.
